name: zcode-token-usage-statusbar
description: ZCode token usage query via the token_usage MCP tool, /usage command, and skill (reads the local usage DB). By default auto-installs the desktop floating usage status bar (modifies app.asar; fully quit and reopen ZCode to take effect; opt-out respected). Appends a per-answer rate line (tok/s, TTFT, output tokens) at the end of each reply.
